CENTRAL POLICE Station.
August 23rd 19 20
REPORT ON Daily Report.
Made by D. S. I. Kay Forwarded by Y. Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,
The Tuchun of Fokien, Li Hou Chi (李厚基), is reported to have requested Gen. Ho in charge of the Shanghai Arsenal, to supply him with 200,000 rounds of rifle ammunition. It is believed that the order will not be complied with, as the quantity of ammunition at the Arsenal is very small.
Representatives of one hundred and seven local societies, including various Guilds, Provincial Associations, Street Unions, etc. met at the Chinese Y. M. C. A., 120 Szechuen Road, at 2.15 p.m. the 21st instant to inaugurate a society to push forward the establishment of the National Citizens' Convention. Kiangs Siang Fu (江湘浦) of the Chinese Ratepayers' Association was elected chairman. Speeches were made by the chairman, Yuan Li Tung (袁履登), Ningpo Provincial Association, Zung Liang Nyoh (陳良玉) Ningpo Guild, David Yu (余日章), Chinese Y. M. C. A., Koh Se Wha (霍守華), Cantonese Guild, Loh Kwe Liang (陸規亮), Kiangsu Educational Association and Yi Tsong Tseu (俞宗周), Ningpo Provincial Association. The speakers all urged the importance of having the Convention established and were unanimous in support of Gen. Wu Pae-fu. It was decided to send petitions to President Hsu, Chin Yun Peng (靳雲鵬), the Premier, and Gen. Wu Pae-fu urging them to take steps to establish the Convention. 1920年8月23日
日报报告。
由副督察长凯（D. S. I. Kay）呈报，经情报处处长转呈。

阁下，
据报，福建督军李厚基已向负责上海兵工厂的何将军请求供应二十万发步枪子弹。据悉，该命令将不会得到执行，因为兵工厂的弹药存量极少。
包括各类会馆、同乡会、马路商界联合会等在内的一百零七个本地团体的代表，于本月21日下午2时15分在四川路120号中华基督教青年会集会，发起成立一个推动召开国民大会的社团。华人纳税会会员江湘浦当选为主席。主席、宁波同乡会袁履登、宁波公所陈良玉、中华基督教青年会余日章、广东公所霍守华、江苏教育会陆规亮以及宁波同乡会俞宗周分别发表演说。发言者均强调召开国民大会的重要性，并一致表示支持吴佩孚将军。会议决定向徐世昌总统、国务总理靳云鹏及吴佩孚将军递交请愿书，敦促他们采取步骤召开国民大会。出席会议者逾千人，会议于下午3时45分结束。今日下午5时，将在广东公所总部宁波路11号举行会议，届时各协会代表将……

A meeting of the Amalgamated Association of Street
Unions was held at their headquarters, 13 Avenue Edward VII,
French Concession, at 4 p.m. the 22nd instant. It was decided
to communicate with all Street Unions regarding steps to be
taken to oppose the levying of the Stamp Duty.
A "Reuter" cable from Kobe dated the 21st instant states
that Wang In Tang, Ex-Chief of the Northern Peace Delegation,
arrived there on that date on the S.S."Yokohama Maru",under
the assumed name of Hsu Pei Chin. This confirms the informa-
tion received from the Japanese Police Magistrate, forwarded
in the Daily Report of the 20th inst.
Viscount Ishii, Japanese Ambassador to Paris, left
here yesterday the 22nd inst. on the S.S." Shidzuoka Maru"
en route for France.
The price of rice remains stationary and ranges from
$14.50 to $9.50 per picul.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
W.W.Kay.
D. S. I.

A/ D. C. I.

马路商界联合会于本月22日下午4时在其总部法租界爱德华七世路13号举行会议。会议决定就反对征收印花税所应采取的步骤，与各马路商界联合会进行联络。
路透社发自神户的电讯称，前北方和平代表团团长王揖唐于本月21日乘“横滨丸”轮抵达该地，化名为徐佩金（Hsu Pei Chin）。这证实了从日本警察署长处获得并于本月20日日报中转报的消息。
日本驻巴黎大使石井子爵昨日（本月22日）乘“静冈丸”轮离开此地，前往法国。
米价保持平稳，每担价格在9.50元至14.50元之间。
